definitions.supplemental_ROI: whole native modeled XY cross-section, depth15..20mm; separately reported
definitions.coordinates: x,y horizontal; z positive depth from top, all positions mm
definitions.weights: saved fractional primary ROI and h^2 dz native full-cell volume; exact face-clipped slab
definitions.whole_XY_geometry: center-in-disk FVM square cells; staircase wall, not exact cylinder clipping; no volume renormalization
definitions.quantiles: stable inverse volume-weighted ECDF, searchsorted side=left; native cell steps/ties retained; no interpolation

metrics.maxTIS: fundamentals only, maximum over2074 sampled directions; lower bound to continuous direction maximum
metrics.RMS: total vector electric-field RMS including all4 stored square_3h spectral lines; not modulation

definitions.omitted: X/Y/Z directional scalar fields not cached; sine/triangle RMS not available in this archive
definitions.current_sum: sum of each physical output RMS including all harmonics/passive-frequency currents; bookkeeping, not common-GND return current
definitions.skin_contact_only: eight skin/contact burden caps, no source-power cap and no1Vpp ceiling; may exceed1Vpp numerically
definitions.legacy_composite_full_skin: same eight caps plus source-power cap and1Vpp ceiling
definitions.equal_current_and_power: no1Vpp ceiling; only named denominator is equalized
definitions.limits: frozen raw same-grid baseline numerical burdens and scalar cutoffs; not human safety/activation limits

comparison.geometry_hold: Pad count also changes strip width and parent-group footprint; square-versus-strip also changes outline/placement. No isolated pad-count or continuum-convergence claim.

skin8.limit_interpretation: Frozen baseline numerical comparison, not human safety or activation limits

circuit.note: C1 basis also separately evaluated at 3030 Hz; square_3h has explicit harmonics

mesh.field_reconstruction: half_face_flux; top contact term averaged over full cell face h^2
mesh.storage: lossless gzip of original little-endian Float64/complex128
mesh.side_bottom_boundary: insulating no outside faces; fixed 50mm cylinder staircase mask
